title: Add post-response identity update step to turn pipeline
description:
Add an identity state update step in chatbot/core/turn.py that uses evolution.calculate_drift and calculate_mood AFTER response generation.

Before editing, inspect:
- TurnPipeline class structure
- ResponseHandler flow
- Session storage mechanism
- evolution.py interfaces from c.1
acceptance_criteria: TurnPipeline.execute_turn() calls evolution updates AFTER response generation
Updated identity/mood values are persisted to session
calculate_drift() and calculate_mood() receive full conversation history
